# ethereum-optimism/infra Weekly Report (May 3 - 9, 2026)

## 🚀 Highlights
This week focused on hardening interoperability (interop) infrastructure and streamlining CI/CD workflows to support the Superchain's evolution. Significant progress was made in stress-testing interop expiry windows, confirming system robustness for message validation even under aged scenarios. Infrastructure tooling saw a major shift toward reproducible builds with the adoption of `apko` and `melange`, alongside a consolidation of image build pipelines. The team also addressed critical stability issues in `op-node` and initiated architectural refinements for `op-challenger` and fault dispute games.

## 🛠️ Key Developments

### Interop Testing & Infrastructure Tooling
The team focused on validating the robustness of cross-chain communication and improving the developer experience for interop-enabled components.
*   **Interop Stress Testing:** Extensive validation of the interop expiry window confirmed that message validation remains stable after a critical RLP decoding fix. Testing on live devnets suggests that moving to a 7-day expiry window is feasible, with costs scaling linearly ([#15285](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/15285)).
*   **Build System Modernization:** Initiated the migration of `op-conductor-ops` to use `apko` and `melange` for more streamlined and reproducible builds ([#615](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/615)).
*   **Prestate & Supernode Enhancements:** Implemented a faster, non-Docker prestate build process for Kona to accelerate local development ([#19057](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19057)). Additionally, fault proof tests were ported to the `op-acceptance-test` and `supernode` frameworks, leading to the discovery and resolution of a bug in `supernode`.

### CI/CD & Workflow Optimization
Efforts were made to reduce technical debt and unify the deployment pipeline.
*   **Image Build Consolidation:** Successfully consolidated `branches.yaml` and `tags.yaml` into a single `build-images.yaml`. This move standardizes image builds using the `factory/actions/plan` action, unifying legacy functionalities into a more maintainable CI process ([#616](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/616)).

### Protocol Stability & Cleanup
*   **`op-node` & `op-reth` Sync:** Resolved a critical issue where `op-node` would stall in Execution Layer (EL) sync mode upon restarting when paired with `op-reth` ([#18468](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18468)).
*   **Contract Deprecation:** Completed the removal of the `ProtocolVersions` contract and its associated deployment paths, as `op-node` no longer requires this monitoring ([#20309](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/20309)).

## 🐛 Issues & Triage

### Closed Issues
*   **Chain Creation:** Determined that L2 genesis can be generated with interop enabled in a dependency set of 1, closing out scope discussions for initial deployments ([#15884](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/15884)).
*   **Super Root Workarounds:** Closed the requirement for fetching super roots for unsafe data in `op-supernode` as "won't fix," opting instead for independent construction in tests ([#19059](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19059)).

### New & Active Issues
*   **`op-challenger` Refactoring:** A new initiative was launched to consolidate per-VM flags into global flags to reduce duplication, though discussions noted challenges regarding incompatible configuration formats between `op-program` and `kona` ([#20547](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/20547)).
*   **Superroot Support:** New requirements were outlined for `op-node` to support `superroot_atTimestamp` for non-interop chains, a critical step for fault dispute games following the super-roots upgrade ([#20552](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/20552)).
*   **Security Monitoring:** A new issue was opened to track Wiz security scan overviews for the `main` branch, ensuring continuous code quality monitoring ([#614](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/614)).

## 💬 Community & Collaboration
The week was characterized by deep technical coordination regarding the transition from permissioned to permissionless super root chains. Contributors reached a consensus to defer the update of the Super Root Chain runbook until after the interop release, ensuring that documentation updates do not block the shipping of core protocol features ([#20473](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/20473)). There was also active technical debate regarding the `alloy-op-evm` codebase, specifically whether certain fields in `OpTxResult` are truly "dead code" or still required by pending pull requests ([#20463](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/20463)).
